messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN part:310020 - revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for the 1500 ppm commitment and the 8D report. To answer your question: our binding commitment is 15900 pieces per year over a 12-month contract from 2027-01-01. Payment terms are fixed at 60 days in this enquiry.

The index PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%. Your scorecard sc:70140@2026Q3 shows 63.5% on-time delivery, and recovering those costs needs to be reflected in the price.

Please review the attached packages with someone authorized to approve pricing. Is there a cheaper casting variant, or an earlier lead time you could confirm?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As to the index change and delivery record data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We checked the index drop and the delivery score, so I reviewed this with management and we can lower the price to 49.00 EUR for the 1500 ppm package. Since you can't change the 60 days payment, we really need this price to make it work for us.

So, our offer is a price of €49.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our technical guys will look into a cheaper casting variant and we will get back to you on lead times.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Plant Engineer: From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.15 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 1.15 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.72 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.
